concepts.name: NDA effective date
justifications: The Agreement expressly states that the Effective Date is 1 February 2027, while signing occurred earlier and effectiveness was deferred.

concepts.name: NDA permitted purpose
predicted: evaluating a possible minority investment by talus ventures ab in fjordsignal as's marine sensor business under project glassfinch.
gold: evaluating a possible minority investment by the recipient in the discloser's marine sensor business under project glassfinch.
values: Evaluating a possible minority investment by Talus Ventures AB in FjordSignal AS's marine sensor business under Project Glassfinch.
justifications: The sole Permitted Purpose is the Recipient's evaluation of a possible minority investment in the Discloser's marine sensor business under the named project.

concepts.name: NDA disclosure window end
justifications: The effective termination notice delivered on 24 November closes the disclosure window on 30 November 2027; the earlier return request does not itself terminate the window.

concepts.name: NDA contractual forum
justifications: The parties designate the courts of Oslo as their contractual forum.

concepts.name: NDA signatory entities
justifications: FjordSignal AS is identified as a Norwegian-registered party and the Discloser, and it signed the Agreement through its Chief Executive Officer.
Talus Ventures AB is identified as a Swedish-registered party and the Recipient, and it signed the Agreement through its Managing Director.

concepts.name: Protected assets at the April snapshot
justifications: These complete assets remain protected at the snapshot: public components do not exclude LUMEN's non-public combination, SHORE's complete package was not previously possessed, CEDAR's authorised public release occurs later, and BASALT's breach-caused publication is not an exclusion. ORACLE is in a late-confirmation gap, while MICA is excluded by proven independent development.

concepts.name: ORACLE timely confirmation deadline
justifications: Counting five eligible Business Days after the 25 March oral disclosure gives 30 March, 31 March, 1 April, 2 April, and 5 April. The deadline expires at 17:00 UTC on the final day.

concepts.name: ORACLE protection timeline
predicted: protection is not continuous in this case. the oral disclosure was provisionally protected from 25 march 2027 until the confirmation deadline at 17:00 utc on 5 april; because the confirmation reached the mailbox on 6 april, protection ended at the deadline, creating a gap until the recipient's written acceptance on 8 april at 10:00. protection resumed prospectively from acceptance only. sending on 5 april did not suffice because delivery occurs on mailbox arrival.
gold: oracle is provisionally protected from the 25 march oral disclosure until 5 april 2027 at 17:00 utc. confirmation sent before that deadline arrived late on 6 april at 09:05, so protection lapses after the deadline. it resumes prospectively when the recipient expressly accepts on 8 april at 10:00 utc; the gap is not cured retroactively.
values: Protection is not continuous in this case. The oral disclosure was provisionally protected from 25 March 2027 until the confirmation deadline at 17:00 UTC on 5 April; because the confirmation reached the mailbox on 6 April, protection ended at the deadline, creating a gap until the Recipient's written acceptance on 8 April at 10:00. Protection resumed prospectively from acceptance only. Sending on 5 April did not suffice because delivery occurs on mailbox arrival.
justifications: The confirmation was delivered after the five-Business-Day deadline, so the provisional protection ended before acceptance and the intervening period was not protected. Mailbox delivery, rather than sending, controls.

concepts.name: Entire SHORE package excluded by prior possession
justifications: The prior repository establishes possession only of the smaller incorporated module, not the complete package. The new branching map, thresholds, and complete combination were not shown to have been previously possessed.

concepts.name: CEDAR end of protection
justifications: The entire ordinary schedule was independently and lawfully released to the unrestricted public on 15 June 2027, ending protection for the exact information on that date. The later identical resend does not create a new disclosure period.

concepts.name: People permitted LUMEN access at the September snapshot
justifications: Elin satisfies the employee undertaking, security-check, and named clean-room approval requirements. Marek qualifies through Talus Research's 52 percent countable voting control and has all required permissions effective, while Oskar qualifies as a professional adviser relying on his enforceable duty of confidence.

concepts.name: Talus Research qualifying voting percentage
justifications: The Recipient's 48 percent direct voting interest plus a presently effective irrevocable proxy over 4 percent produces 52 percentage points of countable general shareholder votes. The revocable proxy, non-voting shares, and economic ownership are excluded.

concepts.name: Marek earliest authorised LUMEN access
justifications: Marek's undertaking and security check were effective by 10 September, but his named clean-room approval expressly became effective on 14 September. The required affiliate voting arrangements were also operating on that date.

concepts.name: Executed competitor consent date for Pia
Q-27 notice deadline date
justifications: Because notification was initially prohibited, the deadline was the earlier of six continuous hours after the prohibition was lifted and the required production time. Six hours after the prohibition was lifted at 11:20 on 5 July 2027 was 17:20 that day.

concepts.name: Q-27 notice lateness in minutes
justifications: The notice deadline was 17:20, and the notice actually arrived at 17:55. The compelled-notice exception requires using actual arrival and prevents after-hours deferral, resulting in 35 whole minutes of lateness.

concepts.name: Q-27 permitted production units
justifications: The final binding narrowing order required all of P1 and only the non-privileged subsection P3A. P2 and P4 were withdrawn, while P3B was privileged and outside the production duty.

concepts.name: WORK-1 deletion deadline
justifications: The return request was delivered on 22 November 2027, earlier than the effective termination. Ten Business Days after that trigger, excluding the specified non-business dates, ends on 7 December 2027; restoration does not restart the deadline.

concepts.name: BK-1 deletion deadline
justifications: BK-1 may remain until the earlier of its scheduled overwrite on 30 December 2027 or 45 calendar days after the 22 November trigger. The scheduled overwrite is earlier, and restoration does not alter that deadline.

concepts.name: Artifacts permitted retention at the December snapshot
justifications: The segregated counsel-held archive qualifies as an archival exception, BK-1 remains within its permitted backup period at the snapshot, and HOLD-1 is covered by a binding preservation order. WORK-1 and NOTE-1 are not covered by a permitted retention exception.

concepts.name: NOTE-1 model training permitted as residual knowledge
justifications: Residual-knowledge permission excludes deliberately recorded notes and quantitative parameters, and training using Confidential Information is independently prohibited without a separate signed licence. No such licence or other applicable exception covers NOTE-1.
